method: Each of the 19 source URLs re-fetched 18 Nov 2026: direct HTTP with the repo's own extractor (app.ingest.extract_text) into /tmp for comparison, plus a browser text fetch for the 11 pages originally saved that way (chevening, daad, gates-cambridge, rhodes, knight-hennessy, schwarzman, commonwealth-shared, rtp, marshall, erasmus-mundus-org, si-pioneering-women) and for RTP whose direct fetch timed out. No raw HTML saved or committed; .txt files updated only on a real content change — none qualified, so no data/raw/*.txt or *.json was rewritten.
